info.title: Reverse Contact API
info.description: Public Reverse Contact API V2 for people and company enrichment, search, fetch, resolve, and usage. Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer rc_... using an API key from the developer dashboard. Every successful response uses a consistent envelope: success, data, error, quotas, metadata. Search endpoints nest results under data.data with pagination in data.metadata. Enrich endpoints nest the primary entity under data.person or data.company. Async live and resolve endpoints acknowledge with data.webhookId; poll GET /v2/webhooks/{webhookId}.

post.description: Synchronously resolves a person from any combination of email, first name, last name, and company domain/name. Returns the full profile of the matched person nested under data.person, with the full profiles of the alternative candidates under data.alternativePersons and data.isFullProfile telling whether the full profile could be assembled. Credits: 2 when a person is found, full profile included. 404 is free.

post.description: Search the Reverse Contact database for people matching filters (AND-combined) and return full profiles. Pass metadata.nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. perPage defaults to 25 and is capped at 100. Results are at data.data and cursor metadata at data.metadata. Filters are strictly validated: unknown fields, blank values and values outside a closed vocabulary return 422 with the offending field and suggestions, and cost 0 credits. Credits: 1 for the search request.

post.description: Describe the people to find in plain language: the prompt is read into People Search filters, then the matching full profiles are returned as a People Search page. The filters applied and anything the prompt asked for that no filter covers are returned at data.interpretation. Pass metadata.nextCursor back as cursor with the same prompt for the next page: a prompt keeps the filters it was read into for 24 hours, so every page runs on the same filters. A cursor sent with filters other than the ones that produced it returns 400 and costs 0 credits. Send filters only through the prompt; to set them explicitly, use /v2/search/people. A prompt no filter can be read from returns 422 NO_FILTERS_INTERPRETED and costs 0 credits. Credits: 1 per page for the search itself, even when no profile matches, plus 1 per profile delivered. A prompt refused before the search costs 0.

post.description: Find the people who look like one seed profile, given by Social profile URL or Reverse Contact person id. The search is built from the seed: its current function and sub-function, seniority and location. The seed is never among the results. Returns full profiles as a People Search page: results at data.data and cursor metadata at data.metadata. Pass metadata.nextCursor back as cursor with the same seed for the next page. Search filters are refused with 422 LOOKALIKE_FILTERS_NOT_SUPPORTED and cost 0 credits. A seed not yet in the search index returns 404 and costs 0 credits. Credits: 1 per profile delivered. A page with no profile costs 0.

bearerAuth.description: API key from the Reverse Contact developer dashboard. Pass as Authorization: Bearer rc_...

creditsConsumed.description: Credits used for this request after pricing resolution

allowDailyOvercost.description: Whether the workspace may exceed its daily cap (Enterprise only)

updatedAt.description: Last upstream update timestamp (ISO 8601). Present only when available.

EnrichedPersonLight.description: Light enrich shape: identity and current role. Used for data.person when the full profile could not be assembled (data.isFullProfile is false), and for an alternative candidate whose full profile could not be retrieved in time.

PersonFull.description: Full person profile shape returned by fetch.

isOpenToWork.description: Whether the profile is flagged open to work

hasPremium.description: Whether the profile has Social Premium

hasVerificationBadge.description: Whether the profile has a verification badge

isInRemembrance.description: Whether the profile is in remembrance

EnrichedCompanyLight.description: Light company enrich shape (identity and headline metrics).

CompanyFull.description: Full company profile shape returned by fetch.

EnrichedPersonFull.description: Full person returned by enrich: the fetch profile plus the identity and current-role fields of the light shape, so a client reading either shape finds its keys.

EnrichedCompanyFull.description: Full company returned by enrich: the fetch profile plus the name, update date and location fields of the light shape, so a client reading either shape finds its keys.

EnrichPersonData.description: Nested under the top-level V2 data field: response.data.person and response.data.alternativePersons.

person.description: Matched person: the full profile (data.isFullProfile true), or the light shape when the full profile could not be assembled (data.isFullProfile false).

alternativePersons.description: Other candidates ranked best first, each with its full profile (it carries experience), or the light shape when its full profile could not be retrieved in time. Always an array (empty when unique).

isFullProfile.description: True when data.person is the full profile, false when only the light shape could be returned.

EnrichCompanyData.description: Nested under the top-level V2 data field: response.data.company.

company.description: Matched company: the full company (data.isFullProfile true), or the light shape when the full company could not be assembled (data.isFullProfile false).

isFullProfile.description: True when data.company is the full company, false when only the light shape could be returned.

data.description: Full profiles returned for this page

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor for the next page

filters.description: People Search filters read from the prompt; the page was searched with exactly these.

exists.description: true if the company exists in the database

specialityCount.description: Number of company specialties when exists is true

webhookId.description: Unique job id (UUID). Poll GET /v2/webhooks/{webhookId} for the result.

pollUrl.description: Convenience path to the polling endpoint for this job

ContactEmailAckData.description: Immediate acknowledgement for the asynchronous Contact Email Finder.

webhookId.description: Unique job id (UUID). Poll GET /v2/webhooks/{webhookId} for the result, or use it to correlate the optional webhook callback.

webhookId.description: Unique job id (UUID). Poll GET /v2/webhooks/{webhookId} for the result, or use it to correlate the optional webhook callback.

pollUrl.description: Convenience path to the polling endpoint for this job

status.description: Job status. created and in_progress are not final; succeeded and errored are.

anyOf.description: Why the job failed (for example email-not-found); null unless status is errored

Set when the result was fetched but the push to your webhookUrl failed (webhook-url-invalid, webhook-url-errored, webhook-url-timeout or webhook-url-unreachable). status stays succeeded and result stays available.

result.description: Job result: a profile object for live fetches, an array for the contact finders. Set when status is succeeded; an errored job returns the payload it stored, if any; null otherwise.

creditsConsumed.description: Credits charged for the job, net of refunds: 0 while the job runs, final once it succeeded or errored
